airRouteControl.name: Concrete body -> complete bottom bed -> bonded DPC body/perpends/upper bed -> wall core below plaster stop -> plaster
rules: First compare the actual bonded mineral assembly as a complete air transition; neither brick absorption nor mortar designation demonstrates its leakage
Include the 30 mm wall-core height above DPC and below plaster stop; do not jump from DPC top -30 to plaster at0
Do not plaster continuously down to wet RC and around the DPC; do not close an air drawing by creating a damp bypass
Concrete moisture resistance, air permeability, crack/joint leakage and gas suitability remain separate duties
Do not assume a new metal return is needed or qualified; if used it needs actual cast-in depth, cage/compaction, weld, movement and plaster-interface evidence

moistureControl.edition: England AD C 2004 with2010/2013 amendments, sections4.17–4.22 and5.5; accessed6November2026
moistureControl.rule: Guidance control, not adoption of a concrete recipe or automatic membrane waiver; preserve the common ground/pile/grid/seat sources and assigned drainage/ventilation duties

airEvidence.role: PHI method guidance, accessed6November2026: identify actual air layers and continuous joined ends. Do not assume a masonry wall supplies its intended plaster air layer. No house target or assembly acceptance transferred.

bondedMasonryResearch.role: Four clay-brick/mortar panel groups had low measured air permeance. Relevant against blanket rejection of an unplastered bonded masonry control, not evidence for WCBL65/M12, this DPC/floor joint, movement, moisture, gas or site performance. No measured value is transferred to the house.

airEvidence.servicesTarget: Proposed q50<=1.0 comparison and single10% floor/wall aggregate pinned under ServicesAir. No owner invariant or assembly performance is adopted. Structural cores belong here; complete service sleeves/collars belong to the separate penetrations10%, not another floor allowance.

ServicesAir.role: Immutable unadopted Services1356 whole-house reference and single aggregate family allocation; not final test envelope or owner target.

thresholdAirOverlap.role: Ordinary dry-side air-control development control, not an actual seal/product or pressure-water closure
thresholdAirOverlap.rule: Steady laminar parallel-plate calculation derived from pressure-driven momentum balance; uniform connected gap, no slip, constant properties. Ideal straight-channel sensitivity only, not a measured joint rating or an adopted allocation. Entrance, roughness, variable gap and end bypass remain actual assembly matters.
thresholdAirOverlap.waterDuty: No source-qualified head assigned to this dry apron behind crest15. Quiet water -35 and geometric crest15 are not a first-leak rating; firstSusceptible remains null. No closed E roof/pipe pressure duty is transferred. Water/capillary/end qualification remains independent.
thresholdAirOverlap.toleranceRole: The2mm movement and1mm edge tolerances are authored challenge bounds, not actual fabrication/installation tolerances. Gap control is an unproven requirement on formed faces and supports, not an achieved fit.
thresholdAirOverlap.ends: No actual end gap or end closure is authored. Every gap result is central only and cannot be credited as total assembly leakage.
thresholdAirOverlap.renewal: Ordinary retention/cover must be independently supported and entirely released before NORTH500 withdrawal; no permanent field-to-pan weld or through-pan fixing. No high preload is inferred from air duty alone.
